integrity: The complete published prior stationary-law result for the same Rikitake flow was inspected at statement and proof level; its global identities and mean-height rigidity are treated as prior coverage. The complete eighteen-page 2008 Darboux-integrability article was inspected for the exact vector field, invariant algebraic surfaces, exponential factors, and first-integral classifications. The global-dynamics source was compared for its Poincare-compactification, invariant-plane, unbounded-orbit, and attractor-creation scope, while the paleomagnetic source was compared for its reversal-statistics scope. The three fiberwise regressions, the vertical variance defect, the equilibrium equality classification, the exact height-product decorrelation, and the threshold-crossing consequence were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not cover arbitrary unbounded Rikitake trajectories.
The heightwise law fixes the conditional first moment of \(xy\) given \(z\), not its complete conditional distribution.
The zero-defect classification uses invariant-probability recurrence.
The original 1958 article was checked through bibliographic metadata and its published abstract rather than a complete searchable full text.
A differently phrased equivalent heightwise identity could remain in unindexed dynamo literature.
title: Heightwise product calibration and vertical-speed rigidity in the Rikitake dynamo
